title: Newborough Warren groundwater analysis pipeline
description:
The analysis pipeline, data and documents of a twenty-one-year dipwell study of the coastal dune aquifer at Newborough Warren, Anglesey, Wales: a state-space model of monthly water-table change per well and per cluster, its out-of-sample tests, climate and forestry scenarios, and the technical report, Methods Supplement and papers built from its outputs.

Software under the MIT licence; data, figures and documents under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE and LICENSE-docs). Pre-submission release line 0.9: the last two parts of the version are the pipeline orchestrator's version (run_analysis.py).
